name: Ray Casting via Grid Line Intersection
definition: A 2D raycasting technique that computes intersections with vertical and horizontal grid lines, then steps cell-by-cell along the ray until a non-zero map cell is found. The closest hit between the vertical and horizontal traces is selected.
summary: This 2D grid-based algorithm traces rays by separately calculating vertical and horizontal grid crossings, selecting the closest intersection, and applying fish-eye correction for rendering.
